lines.text: David says the wicked man has no fear of God, because his eyes are too full of conceit to detect his sin.
The wicked man's words are deceitful, and even on his bed he plots wickedness.
God's loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and His righteousness is like the tallest cedars.
People take refuge in the shadow of God's wings, and with Him is the well of Bethlehem.
David prays for God's loving devotion to reach those who know Him, and the evildoers lie fallen, unable to rise.
